However, in the SPICE netlist provided, U6 is not instantiated as a subcircuit model, so /VCPNB is only connected to C51 which ties it to +24V through a 100n capacitor. There is no voltage source or active model driving /VCPNB to 18V, and the net has no defined DC voltage source maintaining it at 18V throughout the simulation.
